applicationDefects.title: Empty search returns no products instead of the whole catalogue
applicationDefects.source: story.md#L29 (status G3, meaning G4, request G5: provided by the user)
applicationDefects.rationale: GET /products/search?q= (the empty search as defined by G5) answers 200 with total 0 and data [], while GET /products total is 50. AC-7 (with G4) requires a paginated answer whose total equals the catalogue total. Omitting q also returns total 0, so no reading of 'empty search' is met. Mobile 'All tools' screen cannot reuse the search endpoint; workaround is GET /products.
applicationDefects.liveCheck: Replayed live 2026-10-05 (tier 3, api-probe chain confirm/api-repro.md steps 1, 5, 6): GET /products total 50; GET /products/search?q= -> 200 {data:[], total:0, per_page:9, last_page:1}; GET /products/search (no q) -> 200 total 0. Healthchecks OK.
steps: Given the whole catalogue's total from GET /products
Then the answer is 200 and its total equals the whole catalogue
